home.heroTitle: Every everyday tool you need, in one fast page
home.heroSubtitle: Free PDF, image, text and calculator tools that run inside your browser. No upload, no account, no watermark.
home.why1Body: Your file stays in memory on your own machine. The conversion happens there, so there is no queue, no expiry link and no staff reading your documents.
home.why2Body: Static pages, no login wall and no server round-trip. On a slow mobile connection a tool still loads in about a second.
home.why3Body: Phone, tablet or desktop. Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux all ship a browser capable of running these tools.
home.faq1A: Yes. Advertising pays for the hosting, so there is no usage limit, no daily quota and no premium tier.
home.faq2Q: Is it safe to process a contract or an ID document?
home.faq2A: The file is read into browser memory and processed locally; it is never sent to a server. Closing the tab erases it.
home.faq3Q: Do I need to install anything?
home.faq3A: No. Everything runs on the web platform APIs already inside your browser.
home.faq4A: The site opens in English by default. You can switch manually at any time from the header language menu: English, 中文, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Melayu, Bahasa Indonesia and हिन्दी.
home.trustBody: Pick a tool, drop your file, get the result. That is the whole product.

overview.pdf: These PDF tools work on whole documents: combine pages, split ranges, rotate, watermark, compress or convert to images and text, keeping the original layout and page order under your control.
overview.image: These image tools handle everyday photo jobs: compress and convert between JPG, PNG and WebP, resize to exact pixels, build QR codes and favicons, pick colours and assemble animated GIFs.
overview.audio: These audio tools edit sound without a desktop editor: trim and join clips, convert formats, record from microphone, and adjust volume, speed, pitch or equalisation while you listen to the result.
overview.video: These video tools cover quick clip jobs in the browser: compress a recording to a smaller file, or capture your screen and webcam with audio, then download the result straight away.
overview.text: These text and code tools clean and transform strings: count words, convert case, deduplicate lines, encode or decode Base64 and URLs, escape entities, hash, format JSON and compare two versions.
overview.calc: These calculators and converters turn everyday numbers into answers instantly: percentages, BMI, loans and interest, units, colours and dates, with the formula shown so you can check the working.

tip.pdf: Keep a copy of the original before compressing or splitting: compression trades some image quality for size, and a split cannot be undone once you close the tab.
tip.image: For photos prefer JPG or WebP at a sensible quality; keep PNG for logos and screenshots with sharp edges or transparency, since JPG would blur them and drop the alpha channel.
tip.audio: Work on a copy and preview before downloading: trimming and speed changes are destructive to the loaded clip, and re-encoding a lossy file twice adds audible artefacts.
tip.video: Screen and webcam recording needs your permission and a modern browser; close other tabs while recording so the encoder gets enough CPU and the frame rate stays smooth.
tip.text: Everything runs on the text you paste, so you can safely process snippets of code or logs; nothing is sent anywhere, and clearing the box removes it from memory.
tip.calc: Results update as you type and are rounded for display; for money or legal figures keep the unrounded value and double-check against your own spreadsheet before relying on it.
